chapters.text: I'm Bill Badran. For most of your career, the plan was simple: earn, save, invest.
The last climb before retirement is the steepest.
A market drop just as you start withdrawing hurts far more than the same drop at forty.
So your plan has to hold up in bad years, not just good ones.
Your RRSP becomes a RRIF. You choose when your government pensions start.

chapters.text: The strategy that built your savings isn't automatically the one that should pay you.
The goal was never just to reach retirement.
It's knowing what you can spend, where it comes from, and what happens if life changes.
When you're ready, let's look at where you stand.
